The nucleation overpotential for bare Al was 19 mV, and for carbon/Al it was 12 mV. To find the percentage reduction, we calculate:

((19-12)/19)*100 = 36.8%

So, the carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential by approximately 36.8% compared to bare Al.
